reasoning: Tomato field showing sudden, complete collapse of whole plants while foliage remains green — classic symptom of vascular bacterial wilt (Ralstonia solanacearum). Patchy field-level distribution and absence of foliar lesions or fungal signs rule out foliar and fungal diseases. Rapid green wilting is the key differentiator from Verticillium, Southern Blight, and Phytophthora.
